reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music in Provincia! No more abrupt cuts between day, night, title, and combat beds. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a smooth transition, enhancing your colony-building experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
